reference_sql:
WITH month_ends AS (
  -- one row per month end from January 2024 to December 2025
  SELECT CAST(range AS DATE) - 1 AS month_end
  FROM range(DATE '2024-02-01', DATE '2026-02-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
), account_mrr AS (
  -- one row per account and month end
  SELECT a.account_id, m.month_end, COALESCE(SUM(e.mrr_delta_local), 0) AS mrr
  FROM accounts a
  CROSS JOIN month_ends m
  LEFT JOIN subscription_events e ON e.account_id = a.account_id AND e.event_date <= m.month_end
  WHERE a.account_id BETWEEN 1 AND 14
  GROUP BY a.account_id, m.month_end
), compared AS (
  -- one row per account and month end
  SELECT account_id, month_end, mrr,
    LAG(mrr) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY month_end) AS prev_mrr,
    MAX(mrr) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY month_end ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS best_before
  FROM account_mrr
)
SELECT account_id, month_end, mrr AS mrr_local,
    CASE WHEN prev_mrr = 0 AND mrr > 0 AND best_before > 0 THEN 'reactivation'
         WHEN prev_mrr = 0 AND mrr > 0 THEN 'new'
         WHEN prev_mrr > 0 AND mrr = 0 THEN 'churn'
         WHEN mrr > prev_mrr THEN 'expansion'
         WHEN mrr < prev_mrr THEN 'contraction'
         ELSE 'flat' END AS movement
FROM compared
WHERE month_end >= DATE '2025-01-31'

WITH month_ends AS (
  -- one row per month end from January 2024 to December 2025
  SELECT CAST(range AS DATE) - 1 AS month_end
  FROM range(DATE '2024-02-01', DATE '2026-02-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
), account_mrr AS (
  -- one row per account and month end
  SELECT a.account_id, m.month_end,
    (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.mrr_delta_local), 0) FROM subscription_events e
     WHERE e.account_id = a.account_id AND e.event_date <= m.month_end) AS mrr
  FROM accounts a
  CROSS JOIN month_ends m
  WHERE a.account_id BETWEEN 1 AND 14
)
SELECT c.account_id, c.month_end, c.mrr AS mrr_local,
  CASE WHEN p.mrr = 0 AND c.mrr > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account_mrr h WHERE h.account_id = c.account_id AND h.month_end < c.month_end AND h.mrr > 0) THEN 'reactivation'
       WHEN p.mrr = 0 AND c.mrr > 0 THEN 'new'
       WHEN p.mrr > 0 AND c.mrr = 0 THEN 'churn'
       WHEN c.mrr > p.mrr THEN 'expansion'
       WHEN c.mrr < p.mrr THEN 'contraction'
       ELSE 'flat' END AS movement
FROM account_mrr c
JOIN account_mrr p ON p.account_id = c.account_id AND p.month_end = CAST(date_trunc('month', c.month_end) AS DATE) - 1
WHERE c.month_end >= DATE '2025-01-31'

solver.query:
WITH me AS (SELECT last_day(CAST(t.d AS DATE)) AS me FROM generate_series(DATE '2024-01-01', DATE '2025-12-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS t(d)), acc AS (SELECT account_id FROM accounts WHERE account_id BETWEEN 1 AND 14),
bal AS (SELECT a.account_id, m.me, COALESCE(SUM(e.mrr_delta_local), 0) AS mrr FROM acc a CROSS JOIN me m LEFT JOIN subscription_events e ON e.account_id = a.account_id AND e.event_date <= m.me GROUP BY a.account_id, m.me),
w AS (SELECT account_id, me, mrr, LAG(mrr) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY me) AS prev, COALESCE(bool_or(mrr > 0) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY me ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), false) AS earlier FROM bal)
SELECT account_id, me AS month_end, mrr AS mrr_local, CASE WHEN prev = 0 AND mrr > 0 THEN CASE WHEN earlier THEN 'reactivation' ELSE 'new' END WHEN prev > 0 AND mrr = 0 THEN 'churn' WHEN mrr > prev THEN 'expansion' WHEN mrr < prev THEN 'contraction' ELSE 'flat' END AS movement FROM w WHERE me >= DATE '2025-01-31'
